# Queen Hair Braiding

> Black-owned braiding shop based in Austin, Texas. Knotless, boho, Fulani, cornrows, twists and men's braids from Mommy and her ladies in northeast Austin. Gospel on, good company, and you leave feeling like family.

- Phone: (512) 698-6501
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Manor, Round Rock, Hutto, Del Valle
- Google rating: 4.4 from 199 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/queen-hair-braiding/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/queen-hair-braiding/book.html

## Services
- Knotless & box braids: Lightweight knotless or classic box braids in small, medium or large, any length.
- Boho & French curls: Braids with soft curls through the length for that boho, goddess look.
- Cornrows & Fulani: Straight-back, lemonade and feed-in cornrows, plus Fulani braids, with clean parts.
- Twists & soft locs: Senegalese, spring, kinky and island twists, soft locs and retwists.
- Men's braids: Box braids and cornrow designs for men and boys, sharp and clean.
- Updos & special events: Something big coming up? Mommy will help you choose a style and fit you in.

## About
Queen Hair Braiding is run by Elisabeth Ekanga, the woman every client calls Mommy. She has been braiding African hair for more than 30 years, and today she runs this Black-owned shop at 6448 US-290 in northeast Austin with a team of braiders. If you are not sure what to get, she is the one who will help you choose. The gospel music is always on and the ladies keep the room laughing. Some of our clients have been coming for more than 15 years, and some still drive up from San Antonio to sit in our chairs. As one longtime client put it: they are not just my braiders, they are family.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 7:30 PM. Closed Sunday. Hours can change on holidays, so call ahead.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Our prices are on the Services page, from $80 for a retwist to $250 for medium French curls. Call (512) 698-6501 if you have questions about your length or style.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, we work with walk-ins whenever a chair is open. To be sure, call (512) 698-6501 or book online.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through our booking page or call the shop at (512) 698-6501. Clients often get same-day appointments.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 6448 US-290, Austin, TX 78723, in northeast Austin. Look for the pink HAIR BRAIDING posters in the window.
- Q: Do you braid men's hair?
  A: Yes. Men's box braids, cornrows and cornrow designs.
